title: One job reading generation (0) and creating generation (+1) of the same GDG
shapes: BDLD BDLDGDG.jcl: SORTIN DSN=PROD.BDLD.MASTER(0) and SORTOUT DSN=PROD.BDLD.MASTER(+1), both on the one dataset base name
asserts: Both DDs are jcl_datasets facts on the base name PROD.BDLD.MASTER with their relative generation: (0) is read, (+1) is created, and within the job (0) is still the generation that existed before the job started.
